department: Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: The government helps poor families in villages who live in huts to build a concrete house. The budget gave Rs 3.50 lakh per house (this includes work days under MGNREGS). The G.O. for 2024-25 sanctioned Rs 3,10,000 for each house. The money goes straight into your bank account. The house must be at least 360 sq.ft with a kitchen. If you have no land, you get a house site. You can also take a bank or SHG loan of up to Rs 1 lakh if you want.

other: For families in rural (village) areas who live in huts.
Families are picked through a survey and a selection process.

how_to_apply: Families are picked through a government survey of huts. If you are picked, you can build the house yourself, and the money comes to your bank account in parts.
go_number: G.O. (Ms.) No.70, Rural Development and Panchayat Raj (SGS1) Department, dated 15.03.2024
